verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API is fully REST-based (idempotency keys, webhooks, pagination, version fields) meaning core payroll operations can be automated headlessly/via CI, and there's an official MCP server for AI coding tools to interact with the API/docs. However, evidence is entirely for the separate 'Embedded Payroll' partner product (build-your-own payroll platform), not the mainstream Gusto SaaS app itself, and there's no explicit CLI/CI automation testing framework mentioned.
